title: Checkout Page
content: Build e-commerce checkout page. Sections: cart summary (items, quantities, prices), shipping address form, shipping method selection, payment form (card inputs). Order summary sidebar: subtotal, shipping, tax, total, promo code input. Progress steps at top. Express checkout options (PayPal, Apple Pay). Edit links back to each section. Place order button.

variants.simple: Create checkout page with cart summary, shipping, and payment.
variants.detailed: Build e-commerce checkout page. Sections: cart summary (items, quantities, prices), shipping address form, shipping method selection, payment form (card inputs). Order summary sidebar: subtotal, shipping, tax, total, promo code input. Progress steps at top. Express checkout options (PayPal, Apple Pay). Edit links back to each section. Place order button.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive e-commerce checkout page. Layout: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto py-8 px-4. Main content (lg:col-span-2): checkout steps. Progress indicator: horizontal stepper showing Cart > Shipping > Payment > Confirmation, current step highlighted. Express checkout: "Express Checkout" section at top with PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay buttons for one-click checkout. Divider: "Or continue with checkout" line. Shipping section: "Shipping Address" heading. Form: full name, email, phone, address line 1, address line 2, city, state/province dropdown, postal code, country dropdown. Saved addresses: if logged in, selectable saved address cards with "Use this address" button, "+ Add new address". Address validation: inline validation, suggest corrections. Shipping method section: "Shipping Method" heading. Options as selectable cards: Standard (free, 5-7 days), Express ($9.99, 2-3 days), Next Day ($19.99, 1 day). Each shows carrier logo, name, price, estimated delivery date. Payment section: "Payment" heading. Card form: card number (with card type icon detection), expiration (MM/YY), CVV (with ? tooltip), name on card. Saved cards: selectable cards showing last 4 digits. Security badges: SSL, card logos. Billing address: checkbox "Same as shipping" or separate form. Order summary sidebar (lg:col-span-1): sticky top-4 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl p-6. "Order Summary" heading. Cart items: compact list with image, name, quantity, price, edit link. Promo code: input with "Apply" button, applied code shows as removable chip. Pricing breakdown: Subtotal, Shipping (or "Free"), Tax, Discount if applicable, Total (text-xl font-bold). "Place Order" primary button (full-width, prominent). Terms: "By placing your order, you agree to our Terms" text. Trust badges: secure checkout, money-back guarantee, free returns. Edit links: each section has "Edit" link to modify. Mobile: single column, sticky order summary as bottom bar with expandable details. Loading: overlay during order submission. Accessibility: form labels, error messages, focus management between sections.

author: Ersin KOÇ
